page_title: RBL 2-3 LEV | RB Leipzig v Bayer Leverkusen 20/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle. Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+2' Substitution. Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Patrik Schick walks off.

90+1' 2 - 3 Alejandro Grimaldo produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the top left corner. What a brilliant finish. 2:3.
90+1' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

90+1' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
88' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Exequiel Palacios.
87' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matthias Jollenbeck had an easy-decision to make.
84' The game has come to an end for Xavi Simons. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig).
83' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
82' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) whips in a cross from the corner, but Janis Blaswich is well positioned and punches the ball away. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.
80' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
80' A pass into the penalty area from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence. Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
78' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle after Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolas Seiwald departs the field of play to be replaced by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
74' A substitution has been made. Mohamed Simakan goes off and Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) comes on.
74' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Dani Olmo and he is replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) coming on for Benjamin Sesko.
74' The attendance for today's match is 46529.
71' Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) for his blatant foul.
70' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
70' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
69' The free kick is delivered by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
68' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
66' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
63' 2 - 2 GOAL! The corner is whipped in and Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:2.
63' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
62' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
61' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

61' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.

59' Excellent touch by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
56' 2 - 1 GOAL! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) runs onto a pass from Dani Olmo after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 2:1.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.
55' Janis Blaswich pulls off a great save to deny Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
53' Close! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
51' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
50' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
47' 1 - 1 Goal! Alejandro Grimaldo feeds Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 1:1.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) was too forceful with his tackle and Matthias Jollenbeck interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
45+3' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' It looks like David Raum (RB Leipzig) saw red with that tackle. Matthias Jollenbeck won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
42' Benjamin Sesko nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Lois Openda (RB Leipzig), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
41' The game is interrupted. Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
38' It must be a yellow card. It is. Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
35' The foul by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) was seen by Matthias Jollenbeck who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
34' Xabi Alonso is stunned as referee Matthias Jollenbeck shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
32' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
31' Jeremie Frimpong is substituted due to injury. Xabi Alonso gives a chance to Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
31' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) makes a strong challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
27' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
23' The game is interrupted now, Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' Great save! Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Lukas Hradecky.
21' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Lukas Hradecky is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
17' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is adjudged offside.
16' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) commits a rough challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
12' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) was quite harsh and Matthias Jollenbeck didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
9' What a huge chance for Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
7' 1 - 0 Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
6' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
4' It could have been a good chance to score! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) fails to release Benjamin Sesko with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! RB Leipzig will take the kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck is introduced as the referee for today's match.
